title: Minute Out In It: Balanced Rock Sunset (A time lapse of sunset at Balanced Rock. No audio.)
notes: Locked-off sunset time-lapse. Source is PILLARBOXED: 4:3-ish picture inside the 16:9 frame, black bars at x<0.08 and x>0.92 (the square crop removes them). Balanced Rock (boulder on a thin pedestal) at x~0.36, y~0.1-0.75; a big fin of red rock at x~0.72; snowy La Sal Mountains and clouds behind; clouds race across. 0-9 s bright red rock and blue sky (BEST), 9-14 s light warms and shadows climb. A small white car/vehicle appears at the bottom-right of the picture from ~10 s (x~0.78-0.82, y~0.95) - right on the edge of the centre square; use 0-9.5 s or crop slightly left. Original continues into darkness after ~15 s (not included). No people, text or logos.
fact_en: One of the most iconic features in the park, Balanced Rock stands a staggering 128 feet (39 m) tall.
